description: UAE -> Italy. SLOT-CHECK ONLY: reach Step 1 (Appointment Details), then for each centre/category combination read the 'Earliest available slot' banner and report all results via Telegram. No booking is made.

slot_check._comment_labels: Labels must be UNIQUE within a route: a waitlist client file names the combination it wants by label, and two combos sharing one would be ambiguous (the lookup takes the first match, silently registering for the wrong category). These two were both 'Italy Visa Application Center ,Dubai' — now distinguished by their category.
